g.text: PTA FLASH CRYSTALLIZER OTS VER 1 - TEACHING UNIT
PTA MULTISTAGE FLASH CRYSTALLIZER TRAIN V-201 TO V-204
Feed 250 t/h, 30 wt% TA dissolved, 285 deg C from R-101 at 72 bar a
TA crystallized 50 / 85 / 95 / 99 % cumulative; product 74.2 t/h crystals in 169 t/h slurry
1. Flows in t/h; temperatures in deg C; pressures in bar a. Values: simulator design point.
2. Slurry cascades by pressure difference, no pumps. V-201..V-204: ID 3.0 m, T/T 10 m, agitated.
3. E-211..E-231 utility side assumed BFW (steam generation); E-241 cooling water. Condensate route not simulated.
4. Relief, isolation, drains and instrument loops: see P&ID PTA-PID-201.
